title: Pan-Seared Squid with German Beer Stew Sauce
description: A Japanese-inspired dish featuring pan-seared squid with a rich and flavorful stew sauce made with German beer.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Season the squid with salt and pepper.
Add the squid to the pan and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Remove the squid from the pan and set aside.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, and sugar to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil and then reduce the heat to low.
Add the beer to the pan and stir to combine.
Return the squid to the pan and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve the squid with the stew sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped green onions and grated ginger.
